record.paper_title: Some open questions in axion theory
record.original_question: Can one prove the conjecture that every infinite-distance limit of scalar-field moduli space is the ultraviolet endpoint of a renormalization-group flow on an axionic string?

evidence.quote: It has been conjectured that, in fact, every infinite-distance limit of moduli space corresponds to an RG flow UV endpoint of an axionic string [207], and proving this conjecture remains an interesting open problem.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider a four-dimensional effective field theory coupled to gravity whose scalar fields parametrize a moduli space $\mathcal{M}$ equipped with a metric inherited from the kinetic terms. An infinite-distance limit is a sequence of points $p_n \in \mathcal{M}$ such that the geodesic distance $d(p_0, p_n) \to \infty$. An axionic (EFT) string is a codimension-two BPS-like object in the theory that magnetically couples to an axion (a periodic scalar) and whose tension is a positive function of the moduli; the logarithmic backreaction of such a string on the surrounding moduli induces, as one moves radially inward toward the string core, a one-parameter family of moduli configurations that can be identified with a renormalization-group flow of the string's effective couplings. The ultraviolet endpoint of this flow is the limiting locus in $\mathcal{M}$ reached as one approaches the string core; along such a flow, the string tension is required to go monotonically to zero so that the string becomes asymptotically tensionless.

Prove or disprove the following statement (the Distant Axionic String Conjecture): for every infinite-distance limit in the moduli space $\mathcal{M}$ of such a theory, there exists an axionic string in the theory whose induced renormalization-group flow has that infinite-distance limit as its ultraviolet endpoint.
artifact.status_search_result: The Distant Axionic String Conjecture, formulated in the EFT-string program for 4d N=1 supergravity, asserts that every infinite-distance limit of moduli space is realized as the RG-flow UV endpoint of an axionic (EFT) string. Recent works (2021–2025) provide significant evidence and explore consequences (e.g., recovering the Swampland Distance Conjecture and connections to the Emergent String Conjecture), but a general proof has not been given; it remains stated as an open conjecture.

status_evidence.title: The EFT stringy viewpoint on large distances
status_evidence.snippet: any 4d EFT infinite distance limit can be realised as an EFT string flow, and along such limits the EFT string becomes asymptotically tensionless
status_evidence.claim: States the Distant Axionic String Conjecture as a proposal supported by evidence rather than a theorem.

status_evidence.title: EFT strings and dualities in 4d N=1
status_evidence.snippet: EFT strings and dualities in 4d N=1 (2025)
status_evidence.claim: Recent (2025) work continues to investigate the conjecture, indicating it is still an active open problem.

status_evidence.title: Large Field Distances from EFT strings (CORFU2021)
status_evidence.snippet: The Distant Axionic String Conjecture essentially claims that all 4d EFT infinite distance limits are realised by the RG flow associated to an EFT string.
status_evidence.claim: Refers to the statement as a conjecture under investigation.
